Kya tumhein us waqiye (yani qayamat) ki khabar pahunchi hai jo sab par chah jaye ga ?
Bohat se chehre us din utre hue hon ge.
Museebat jhilte hue, tahakan se chor.
Woh dehakti hui aag mein dakhil hon ge.
Unhein khaulte hue chashme se pani pilaya jaye ga.
Un ke liye ek siway-e-kanty daar jhaar ke siwa koi khana nahin hoga.
Jo na jism ka wazan barhaye ga aur na bhook mitaye ga.
Bohat se chehre us din trotaza hon ge.
(duniya mein) apni ki hui mehnat ki wajah se poori tarah mutmaeen.
Alishan jannat mein hon ge
Jis mein woh koi laghaw baat nahin sunen ge.
Us jannat mein behte hue chashme hon ge.
Us mein unchi unchi nshstin hon gi.
Aur samne rkhe hue pyale.
Aur qataar mein lagaye hue gdaz takiye.
Aur bchhe hue qalin.
To kya yeh log unton ko nahin dekhte ke unhein kaise paida kya gaya ?
Aur aasman ko ke use kis tarah buland kya gaya ?
Aur paharon ko ke unhein kis tarah gara gaya ?
Aur zameen ko ke use kaise bchhaia gaya ?
Ab (ae payghumbar) tum naseehat kiye jao. Tum to bas naseehat karne wale ho.
Aap ko un par zabardasti karne ke liye musallat nahin kiya gaya.
Haan magar jo koi moonh more ga, aur kufr ikhtiyar kare ga.
To Allah us ko bara zabardast azab de ga.
Yaqeen jaano un sab ko humare paas hi lot kar aana hai.
Phir yaqeenan un ka hisab lena humare zimme hai.
